title: Isigodlo Sengilazi Ebumbwe
intro: Cabanga ngezwe elikude elinothile nobukhazikhazi lapho ilanga likhulekelwa khona esikhundleni soMdali walo. Incwadi ifika iphethe ubizo olungenakunakwa, bese kuqala uhambo oluya enkantolo enkulu kunanoma iyiphi eyake yabonwa ngaphambili. Lapho, inkohliso izodalulwa yiphansi elikhohlisa amehlo, futhi umzuzu wokucaca uzoshintsha konke.
clues: Ngabusa izwe elichumayo elinabantu abakhothamela ilanga esikhundleni sika-Allah.
Ngithole incwadi enhle engibiza ngokuthi angiziphakamisi kodwa ngizithobe ku-Allah.
Ngixoxe nomkhandlu wami ngakhetha ubuholi bezombusazwe kuqala, ngathumela isipho ukuze ngihlole umthumeli.
Ngafika kuSulayman, futhi isihlalo sami sobukhosi sanikezwa kimi sifihliwe ukuze kuhlolwe ukuqashelwa kwami.
Ngangena esigodlweni esiphakeme engangicabanga ukuthi iphansi laso elibushelelezi lengilazi liyimanzi ajulile.
Ngamemezela ukuzithoba kwami ​​​​kuSulayman ku-Allah, iNkosi yemihlaba.

trial.label: Isivivinyo/Umcimbi
options: Ngihlaselwe ukugula iminyaka eminingi nokulahlekelwa umndeni
Uyalwe ukuba anikele ngengane ayithandayo ephusheni
Kuhlolwe yisihlalo sobukhosi esifihliwe kanye nesigodlo sengilazi
Waphonswa emlilweni ovuthayo ngenxa yokuphula izithombe
trial.answer: Kuhlolwe yisihlalo sobukhosi esifihliwe kanye nesigodlo sengilazi

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: Ngahlala ngingakholwa futhi ngabhujiswa kanye nabantu bami

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
